messages.content: 你能先幫我找一個素食，主菜的食譜嗎？並且能在30分鐘內準備好嗎？之後，能否請你找出重力的科學發現的詳細資料，使用預設的方法？完成後，我也想知道使用同樣方法發現希格斯玻色子的相關資料。最後，能否幫我找一個能在45分鐘內準備的無麩質甜點食譜？

function.name: find_recipe
function.description: Find a recipe based on the dietary restrictions, recipe type, and time constraints. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

dietary_restrictions.description: Dietary restrictions e.g. vegan, vegetarian, gluten free, dairy free.

recipe_type.description: Type of the recipe. E.g. dessert, main course, breakfast.

time.description: Time limit in minutes to prep the meal.

function.name: science_history_get_discovery_details
function.description: Retrieve the details of a scientific discovery based on the discovery name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

discovery.description: The name of the discovery, e.g. Gravity

method_used.description: The method used for the discovery, default value is 'default' which gives the most accepted method.

message.reasoning:
We need to call two functions: find_recipe twice, and science_history_get_discovery_details twice. The user wants:

1. A vegetarian main course recipe that can be prepared within 30 minutes.
2. Details about the discovery of gravity using default method.
3. Details about the discovery of Higgs boson using same method (default).
4. A gluten-free dessert recipe that can be prepared within 45 minutes.

We should call find_recipe with dietary_restrictions="vegetarian", recipe_type="main course", time=30. Then call science_history_get_discovery_details with discovery="Gravity". Then call science_history_get_discovery_details with discovery="Higgs boson". Then call find_recipe with dietary_restrictions="gluten free", recipe_type="dessert", time=45.

We need to output the results of each function call. The user wants all four results. We should do them sequentially. The order: first find_recipe for vegetarian main course, then science_history_get_discovery_details for Gravity, then science_history_get_discovery_details for Higgs boson, then find_recipe for gluten free dessert.
